findings.issue: “aromas” names scents; הסמים is a definite masculine plural noun for the spice substances.
“al santo” reads as a person; לקדש is a common noun of holiness or a holy thing, not a personal saint.

notes: Conjunction, construct definiteness, ככל אשר, piel 1cs+2ms, and qal imperfect 3mp otherwise match.
